notes: Title 24 uses a flat per-section URL convention (no intermediate chapter slug in URLs). The Legislative Lobbyist Disclosure Act in the 2025 codification is sections 24:50-58.1 (24:59 repealed). Sections 24:61-63 (Short title / Declaration of policy / Definitions) belong to the Emergency Interim Legislative Succession Act (24:61-75) and are intentionally excluded - they are NOT part of the lobbying-disclosure regime despite their proximity in numbering. These per-section URLs are leaves (statute text, not directory pages).
